# Problem and result

Describe a concrete trigger and resulting behavior. Link the Issue with `Refs #N`, the reviewed plan and affected surface.

## Verification

Record focused regression tests, required repository checks, visual evidence for visible changes, and limitations. Link evidence; do not imply checks that were not run.

## Delivery

State the proposed version, owner review status, counterpart PR when safe to link, and remaining installation/release/deployment actions. Keep the delivery Issue open until acceptance and live evidence are complete. Record rollback when relevant.
